# JustWatch

> JustWatch is a streaming guide that helps users find where to watch movies, TV shows, and live sports across streaming platforms like HBO Max, NBA League Pass, and more.

The platform provides comprehensive streaming schedules and availability information for entertainment content and live sports, including NBA games, NCAA basketball, MLB, and premium streaming services. JustWatch serves as a centralized search engine for discovering content across multiple streaming providers.
